processes.trading_book_setup_access: Requesting new trading books, curves or access/hierarchy mappings in risk and deal systems (TDS, Sitara, TAGG, RisktRAC) from the book-admin groups and following up until officialized.
processes.deal_price_invoice_discrepancy: Correcting a deal price, volume or counterparty in the deal system after a settlements or counterparty invoice mismatch is reported.
processes.credit_report_counterparty_rebooking: Receiving the periodic credit report listing counterparties to rebook or pending actions and forwarding it so deals can be rebooked.
processes.eol_product_trader_book_mapping: Confirming with desk heads and updating the EOL product to trader/book mapping spreadsheet by a deadline.
processes.deal_termination_bankruptcy_book_move: Moving auto-terminating or terminated deals into designated books after a counterparty bankruptcy or unwind request.
processes.daily_pnl_support: Answering questions about and sending daily P&L, top-level adjustments and month-end last-day files to desk and accounting.
processes.month_end_last_day_file: Confirming the last-day file is complete and supplying economics reports at month end.
